info.title: 2151 Kundiya Mahayagya API
info.description:
Backend for **2151 Kundiya Mahayagya** (14-21 December 2026): family registration,
best-fit Kund allocation, QR passes, per-member check-in, admin and reporting.

* All responses use the envelope `{"success": true, "data": ..., "meta": ...}` or
  `{"success": false, "error": {"code", "message", "details"}, "request_id"}`.
* Staff endpoints need `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` from `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.
* `POST /api/v1/registrations` requires an `Idempotency-Key` header.

schema.title: Response Liveness Api V1 Health Get

get.description: Database reachable, migrations applied and seed data present.

post.description: Staff login (ADMIN / SUPERVISOR / SCANNER). Returns a short-lived JWT.
OAuth2 password form variant (used by the Swagger UI "Authorize" button).
Invalidates ALL tokens of the current user (token version bump).

Register a family (1-8 members) for one or more sessions.

All selected sessions are allocated atomically (one Kund per session,
best-fit, never split). If any session cannot be allocated, nothing is
booked and a 409 CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE explains which sessions failed.
The response contains the family's QR pass token -- shown only here.

post.description:
Family pass retrieval for the holder of the pass token.

The token travels in the request BODY (never in the URL) so it does not
end up in proxy/access logs. Unknown, revoked and expired tokens return the
same 404 to avoid an oracle; requests are rate limited per IP.
Download the family QR pass as PNG or SVG (valid passes only).

Public status check by booking number + registered primary mobile.

Returns no names or contact data. Rate limited per IP and per booking
number to prevent brute-force enumeration.
Backend QR validation for staff tools (no roster; scanners use /scanner/scan).

schema.title: Response Validate Pass Api V1 Qr Validate Post

post.description: ADMIN/SUPERVISOR help-desk action: revoke the current pass and issue a new one.
Revoke the family's active pass (e.g. reported lost). Regenerate to issue a new one.

get.description: The scanner's assigned session (derived server-side from the account).

post.description:
Scan a family pass. Returns the roster + Kund for the session.

Business outcomes are returned with HTTP 200 and a ``status`` (+ ``reason``)
so scanner apps can render them uniformly.

Check in ONE family member (by member number).

Statuses: CHECKIN_SUCCESS, ALREADY_CHECKED_IN, INVALID_QR, INVALID_SESSION,
INVALID_MEMBER, BOOKING_CANCELLED. Supplying the same ``event_id`` again
(e.g. after a network retry) is idempotent.
